rows.title: Running coding agents without handing them my credentials
rows.author: antoniomika
rows.summary: Running coding agents without handing them my credentials Running coding agents without handing them my credentials The credential problem Keeping the socket stable across reconnects Secrets the agent never sees Answering agent prompts from the laptop What lend doesn't protect against to let remote agents use tools on my laptop with my approval. An agent can start Codex in another pane, give it a prompt, wait for it to finish, and read what it said: herdr agent start reviewer --kind codex --pane herdr agent prompt reviewer "Review the diff on am/fix-retries" reviewer --source recent Remote hosts work the same way.
